<reason>PRO won a competitive debate by tying the motion’s actual decision rule—whether disposal may remain a legal default—to CON’s own admission that incentives still leave the dumpster open whenever it is cheaper. CON had the sharper mechanism on ex ante ordering risk and credit-versus-duty verification, but spent too much force on five-employee grocers off a “large supermarket” motion and never showed why optional credits beat a last-use floor once waste is cheaper than coordination. PRO made the clash easier to vote.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>PRO’s Q1 forced CON to say stores stay free to trash lawful food when the dumpster is cheaper; PRO then converted that yes into the live vote issue, while CON’s strongest reply (compliance risk attaches at 8am ordering) never fully unseated it.</best_rebuttal>
